goal: Generic evaluator-facing manifest review, approval, freeze-readiness and results presentation UI
runtime_rule: PUBLIC_READ may render static projection; comments/change requests/approvals/freeze require an authorized StegVerseEvaluatorReviewBridge and fail closed when absent.
acceptance: A participant receiving only the URL can understand the test, challenge it, request changes, approve an exact revision/hash when authorized, see same-version readiness, verify a frozen hash when present, and later inspect neutral results without GitHub knowledge.
